notes.title: Cloud Saves, Trading Cards, 35% Discount, and a surprise!
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce that Steam has given us the go-ahead to introduce Steam trading cards for Intruder in Antiquonia! After careful consideration, we've decided to feature all the female characters from the game on these cards. Depending on your playtime, you should already find some in your Steam account.

In addition, we've implemented Steam cloud saves, enabling you to continue your adventures across different devices and operating systems, provided you're logged into Steam. If you encounter a warning about conflicting saved games, it's likely due to overlapping auto-saves or duplicate game names on two devices. This should only occur the first time you play on a new device. In such rare instances, Steam UI allows you to choose which device takes precedence.

To celebrate this significant update, we're offering our biggest week-long discount yet. If you haven't purchased the game yet, now's the perfect time - enjoy a 35% discount!

But wait, there is one more thing 😉. We've been diligently working on our next point-and-click adventure, Shadows of the Afterland. Today, we're excited to share that you can finally add it to your wishlist:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2506100/Shadows_of_the_Afterland/

Thank you so much for your support!

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41353745/9c27a74f89974267b9469e772aab3ffa3e767f5d.png[/img]

First of all, thank you so much for the incredible support we have received so far! We never dreamed that our first commercial game would be so well received, and we are truly grateful to all of you.

Your reviews, whether positive or negative, are very helpful to us. Knowing what we did well and what we need to improve helps us grow, and our next game will reflect the great feedback we have received from your reviews.

As many of you know, Steam has a few thresholds for reviews (10, 50, 500), beyond which the wording describing the sentiment of the reviews, as well as the visibility that the Steam algorithm gives to the game, are changed.

We are close to the 50 reviews threshold and could use your help to reach it. If you have played the game and were thinking about writing a Steam review, now would be a great time to do it.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1778870

Thank you so much!

notes.title: INTRUDER IN ANTIQUONIA COMING TO STEAM ON JULY 8, 2022!
notes.content:
The wait is over! After 18 months of hard work, Intruder In Antiquonia will be available on July 8th on Steam.

If your idea of a relaxing evening where you forget your everyday worries is exploring beautiful locations filled with interesting challenges, then this adventure game is for you! And if you long for the days of classic point-and-click adventure games, you must try the demo right away.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41353745/cae85a322e844f156c6e66a4ce31b49e15442eab.png[/img]

The story takes place in the present day, when Sarah is found lying on the road leading to the town of Antiquonia. After recovering, she is diagnosed with amnesia and must stay in the town to learn about her past. She will soon discover that the internet is not welcome in this town, a detail that will prove difficult as she begins to unravel the mystery of her past.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41353745/26c2976b367b9d4d60d8c9e0aa6255a68f152853.png[/img]

Intruder in Antiquonia is a classic 2D point-and-click adventure game with high-resolution graphics designed by professional illustrators, a beautiful soundtrack written by an experienced composer, and an intuitive user interface. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41353745/9a86c17397c408469692fdd4a3b1ac34c8e45c7e.jpg[/img]

The game will be coming to Steam on July 8, for Linux, Mac, and Windows. In the meantime, a demo is available for download on the Steam page.


More details and screenshots can be found in the press kit here: 
Press kit: https://arumastudios.com/intruder-in-antiquonia/press-kit

notes.title: New update for Intruder In Antiquonia Demo
notes.content:
[h3]Hi adventurers![/h3]

In preparation for Steam Next Fest, which starts on February 21, we have just released a major update for the[i] Intruder in Antiquonia[/i] demo. Here are the main highlights of this update:

- Many improvements to the dialogues, including simplification and removal of confusing parts.
- Added hints to clarify the next objective in some parts of the game.
- Added custom cursors to clarify what to expect when you click on interactive points on the screen.
- All known rendering bugs have been fixed.
- Added many more interactive points in various locations to enrich the world.
- The UI is now the same size on all monitors.
- The volume controls are now more finely graduated.
- Music fades when you move between locations where different songs are playing.
- The clickable areas for some objects have been fine-tuned so you do not accidentally click on them.
- Revised the hostel table to better highlight important objects.
- Ensured that time references (e.g. "good morning") are only used when relevant.
- Improved character positions and movements to make them feel more natural.

We hope you enjoy it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41353745/2adf7c97acd5c58786e69042906398cd4eb278c0.gif[/img]

PS: This is not the end yet. We are preparing another set of improvements, mainly focused on dialogues, to be released later this month.
